summary: Full MVP test of Minha Adega wine e-commerce (pt-BR, BRL). Backend: 20/21 pytest cases passed (the 1 error is a pytest-xdist parallel-fixture artifact where session-scoped register fixture is invoked twice by different workers — not a real bug; endpoint itself works fine and returns 400 duplicate correctly). Frontend: all critical UX flows verified via Playwright — Home, Catálogo (search/filter/sort), Wine Detail, Pairing (real AI Claude Sonnet 5 returned 3 recs for 'picanha grelhada' with genuine explanation, no fallback banner), Cart (coupon PRIMEIRAADEGA discount applied → R$ 3.919,90 total), full Checkout + demo confirm redirected to /conta with order visible, Owner login (mgrodrigues920@gmail.com) landed with role=owner, Painel Admin visible, /admin tabs (Visão Geral R$ 10.471,70 revenue + Pedidos + Catálogo + Relatórios) all functional, non-admin/anonymous redirected from /admin to /, and mobile viewport 390x844 shows bottom nav with all 5 items (Início, Explorar, Harmonizar, Carrinho, Conta).

minor.issue: pytest-xdist runs session-scoped customer_token fixture twice (once per worker) causing duplicate register 400 on one worker — cosmetic test artifact. Adding `--dist loadfile` or scope='module' would eliminate this. Not a product bug.

issues: Repeated /api/auth/me 401 console errors on unauthenticated pages — AuthContext probes session at every mount. Not a bug, but consider swallowing 401 silently in the axios interceptor to keep console clean.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `checkout` calls `checkout_quote(payload)` (the coroutine returns a dict) but then decrements stock BEFORE persisting order — if the DB insert fails, stock is left decremented. Consider wrapping in try/except with rollback.

server.py: `checkout` does not filter out archived/inactive wines from the `quote` reservation loop consistently — quote raises 400 for archived, good; but the increment is per-item and lacks atomic rollback across items if one succeeds and next fails. Low risk for MVP.
server.py: JWT_SECRET has a dev default text in .env — must be rotated for prod.
server.py: CORS `allow_origins=['*']` with `allow_credentials=True` is invalid per spec (browsers reject). Currently the `allow_origin_regex='.*'` covers it, but tidy up.
AdminPage.jsx uses browser confirm() for archive — consider a themed dialog for consistency.
test_credentials: Owner mgrodrigues920@gmail.com / Adega@Owner2026; test customer registered dynamically per run (cliente.teste.<ts>@example.com / Teste@123).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 8 wines and owner user on startup — verified. Test run created 1 approved order for the test customer + prior orders visible in admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full MVP is stable. AI pairing works with real Emergent LLM key (Claude Sonnet 5). Checkout uses two-step: POST /api/checkout then POST /api/orders/{id}/confirm-demo. Coupon PRIMEIRAADEGA = 10% off. Shipping tiers: CEP starting 0/1/2 = R$29,90 else R$49,90. For xdist run, consider pytest with -p no:xdist or run sequentially to avoid duplicate-register 400.
rca of the issue: No product bugs found. The pytest-xdist artifact stems from `customer_token` being scope=session but xdist creates 1 session per worker — both workers hit /api/auth/register with the same email; the second returns 400. Fix: use unique email per worker (worker_id fixture) or set scope='module' with cleanup.
